reasons.UNSUPPORTED_TEXT_FORMAT: A summary cannot be produced from this type of file. Supported: PDF, DOCX, TXT.
reasons.DOCUMENT_UNREADABLE: The file cannot be read — it may be damaged or password-protected.
reasons.OLD_DOC_FORMAT: The old .doc format cannot be summarised. Save the file as .docx and try again.
reasons.DOCUMENT_SCANNED: The file looks like a scanned document — images without a text layer. A summary needs a file text can be extracted from.
reasons.DOCUMENT_TOO_SHORT: Not enough readable text was found in the file ({{words}} words). At least {{min}} words are needed for a summary.
reasons.DOCUMENT_NO_TEXT: No readable text was found in the file.
reasons.AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The monthly AI cost cap has been reached. New processing will be possible next month, or after an admin raises the cap.
reasons.NO_KEY_POINTS: The AI analysis produced no key points.
